beats.headline: All aboard
beats.text: They land on a red-line train already filling with Drek babies, and Carl finds the Protective Shell's best trick: cast on a straight run of track, it stays put while the train keeps moving, so it sweeps every car behind it clean. Donut's class must change now, and on six minutes' notice she becomes a Football Hooligan; Mordecai notices, and tells nobody, that she keeps any skill she levels even once. A court order lands on the AI's desk over the third floor, and its apology is a free personal space: beds, showers, a crafting studio and a training room. Mordecai has them on a schedule: two hours' sleep, buffs, an hour in the training room, a bench. Katia, whose constitution doubles on a moving train, goes through every door first. In the personal space Carl finds a folder he had missed, Messages from deceased Crawlers. Brandon held the line on the third floor so Imani and Elle could reach the stairs, and he asks Carl to tell Chris that he loved him. The Tangle is a maze of looping lines and transfer stations, every one numbered with a prime, and the NPCs who work it believe in wives and houses they have never had. Vernon the conductor dies under Donut's prize suitcase, which is full of burning ants. Then a fan box spins up the Prize Carousel, Mordecai throws a chair at its host and is suspended for seven days, and Carl passes over his father's old Harley to choose a thick book with an anarchy sign on the cover.

beats.headline: The Cookbook
beats.text: The book is the Dungeon Anarchist's Cookbook, and Carl is its twenty-fifth holder. Crawlers from other worlds and other seasons have carried it down and written in its margins: bomb recipes, notes on NPCs, a brother's grief, a philosopher's last essay. At the Desperado Club they hire two rock-monster bodyguards, Bomo and the Sledge, and meet Elle, a floating Frost Maiden now, and Imani, who tells them Chris picked a rock race, turned hard, and went off hunting. Donut dances on the Sledge's shoulders, is jumped by two crawlers, and kills one of them. A skull appears after her name, which she never wanted. Elle puts an icicle through the other and tells the room that anyone who comes for Donut comes for all of them. The club's assistant manager, a hand-sized sprite called Astrid, apologises in person and makes the bodyguards permanent. Carl spins the casino wheel on a hundred-thousand chip and wins a Scroll of Upgrade for his toe ring. He derails a train to get at its engineer, Gore-Gore, and learns two things about the Tangle: at station 435 the crews are wiped through a portal, and each punch of the gauntlet on a worshipper of Grull adds a point and a half towards summoning him. Carl stops at ten and a half by drop-kicking the mantaur onto the third rail. Sponsors arrive: the Valtay for Carl, Princess D'nadia for Donut, and Princess Formidable of the Skull Empire, the Maestro's little sister, for Katia. Donut takes the head off a war mage with Hole.

beats.headline: Stealing the Nightmare Express
beats.text: Carl fist-bumps every crawler in the club and starts a chat network, so that what one of them learns, everyone learns. Then he steals a train. The Nightmare Express is a black steam engine towing forty cages of monsters. He stands in its tunnel, casts the shell as it arrives to wipe every car clean, misses the jump for the platform, is hit by the engine, and climbs in through the cab window to find two dead engineers and a boiler about to blow. Fire Brandy, a lesser demon who stokes the firebox and gives birth to her fuel, talks him through the valves. The train takes them to station 436, one past the end of the line, where every colour of train is thrown engineless into a burning pit a mile across. The souvenir conductor hats handed out on day one are keys out of it. Through a repair portal they reach a trainyard overrun by ghouls, where a grease gremlin called Widget tells them about the Escape Velocity line and a second after that the ghoul behind him tears his head off. Madison from human resources explains that the six Terminus stations are mimics, and that the six-armed Kravyad who guard the crews are paid in dwarves. Katia gives Carl a slip of paper she saw Donut hide under the track: a player-killer coupon with his name on it. At the club a drunk, one-handed Frank Q slips Carl a Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering as his revenge. That ring is why nothing could heal Yvette.

beats.headline: Hekla
beats.text: On a beauty-pageant show filmed from a submarine, Carl refuses to read the script and steals the fridge shelves, the makeup table and the couch. Donut explains the coupons: she buried his under a track and threw Katia's in a bin. Frank Q is dead at the club bar, killed by Chris. Then Hekla arrives in the personal space with thirty of Brynhild's Daughters: a thousand crawlers are stranded at station 101, Li Jun's team among them, and a train is waiting at 60. Katia volunteers to be its plough, a ton and a quarter of scoop bolted to the front, because the Daughters came back for her and nobody ever has before. Carl does not trust Eva, the four-armed enforcer at Hekla's shoulder. In the middle of the ghoul horde, Donut's new goggles show Hekla putting invisible bolts into Katia's back, and the healer riding with them waiting for orders before she heals. The plan was to have Katia die, Carl lose his temper, Hekla put him down, and the Daughters inherit Donut and Mordecai. Donut puts a full-strength missile into Hekla's face. Eva mocks Katia in her own voice until Katia uses Rush, which she hates, and misses Eva by inches. Hekla hits the cab wall instead, and does not get up. Donut raises the corpse three times over and throws Eva out of the window. Katia now has a golden skull over her head and half a million gold on her own head, and an agent called Loita, from the party that runs Borant, lays claim to their account.

beats.headline: Six hundred hats
beats.text: Six hundred crawlers are stranded at the pit with no hats, and station 75's yard holds ten rapid-response carts whose blades are portals: set them to the abyss to clear a line, or to a trainyard to rescue whoever is standing on it. Each cart wants two gnoll left hands to start. The only gnoll is Growler Gary, a bartender who cannot leave his bar and comes back to life every time he dies. Carl explains why, and Gary says yes. The recap plays it for laughs and shows none of the reason. The carts go out playing whatever the alarm trap picks, Physical by Olivia Newton John among them, and when Bautista's cart fails to arrive Carl rides the Mindaro line himself. On the way he accidentally sends a whole station mimic to trainyard E, and there are hats enough for everyone: six hundred crawlers step through the great portal to safety. A line of them lay their own hats at Donut's feet and bow. Carl sends the battered Vermillion engine down the tunnel full of dynamite and blocks the ghouls short of station 36. Stage-three DT monsters begin to burst into thousands of rice-sized Krakaren. Mordecai comes back from his seven days to find two new skulls on the team, Katia exploding in a shower of stored blood, and a ring he makes Carl take off with a smack to the head. Then he explains the map: from above, the lines make the Syndicate logo, and the pit is the centre of the galaxy.

beats.headline: The Tangle eats itself
beats.text: At one day left the Iron Tangle announces its own destruction. The centres of the stations fall away and the Krakaren pour up into every room. At station 36 they pour straight into a portal cart Carl has hung nose-down over the hole on Imani's chain. The plan is to blow every ghoul generator in the system at once, and on the far side of the knot Prepotente, a talking goat with a patient taste for murder, and Miriam Dom are doing the same thing. Carl sends a province boss to the abyss that Prepotente was two hours from killing, and Donut is called delightful. Then a neighbourhood boss clamps a hand around Carl's foot and drags him through a portal into Trainyard E. The world freezes and the heavy metal starts: a Death Challenge. On one side a level-ninety Mimic Rex. On the other the war god Grull, summoned through the gauntlet and driven, the announcer says, by his sponsor: the Maestro, alive after all. Grull splits the mimic in half and steps on Carl, who survives it on Mordecai's Special Brew. Elle bounces icicles off the god's head, Katia turns herself into Carl and stands on a wrecked train giving him the finger, and Li Na brings a second vessel, arms and legs removed, to throw into the portal. The god goes with it. Fire Brandy and the conductor Tizquick ride the Nightmare Express into the pit to blow the generators, and the survivors live. On the stairs Carl writes in the Cookbook that twenty-four crawlers before him talked about burning this place down, and none of them did. I will break them all.
